page.title: Connections
page.description: Manage email, collaboration, code hosting, and other service connections on one page.

unified.title: Every connection in one place
unified.description: Each item is simply a connection—there are no separate app and channel areas. You control personal accounts; workspace connections follow workspace permissions.
unified.more_connections_description: Connect Outlook, Notion, and other services your agents can use.

gmail.description: Connect Gmail to analyze new mail and send customer emails after reviewing a draft in Chat.
gmail.needs_attention: Needs reauthorization or recovering by polling
gmail.empty_description: Choose a Google account and allow reading and sending mail. Only new mail is analyzed by default. You review each draft and click Send in Chat.
gmail.not_configured: Your administrator has not enabled secure Gmail authorization yet.
gmail.analysis_not_configured: Email receiving is available, but automatic analysis will wait until an administrator configures a model.
gmail.connect_failed: Couldn't start Gmail authorization. Try again.
gmail.toast_connected: Gmail connected; new mail will sync automatically
gmail.toast_connect_failed: Gmail authorization wasn't completed. Try again
gmail.auto_analysis_description: Only mail requiring attention enters your watchlist.
gmail.disconnect_confirm_description: {{email}} will stop syncing and sending. Its copied messages, analysis, drafts, sending records and authorization will be removed. You can reconnect later.
gmail.toast_scopes_required: Allow both reading and sending mail to complete the Gmail connection.

apps.title: Connected apps
apps.description: Connect personal accounts your agents can use on your behalf. These connections follow you across workspaces.
apps.description_limited: Choose Gmail or Outlook, then sign in and approve access. Existing app connections remain visible here.
apps.easy_connect_description: We use the provider's secure sign-in flow. You never enter your email password, IMAP settings, or app password here, and you can disconnect at any time.

channels.title: Messaging channels
channels.description: Connect workspace agents to messaging platforms so people can work with them from existing conversations.
channels.feishu_description: Manage the Feishu or Lark bot assigned to each agent.
channels.slack_description: Manage the Slack bot assigned to each agent.
channels.empty_description: Ask a workspace administrator to enable a messaging provider.

code.title: Code hosting
code.description: Connect self-hosted Git providers for pull request mirroring and webhook delivery.

retry_description: Check your connection and try again.
not_configured_description: This server has not configured the app connection service. Contact your administrator.

composio.empty_description: No connectable apps are configured for this deployment yet.
composio.no_results_description: Try a different app name or category.
composio.connect_failed: Couldn't start the connection. Please try again.
composio.disconnect_confirm_description: {{app}} will be revoked and your agents will lose access. You can reconnect later.
composio.connections_load_failed: Existing connections couldn't be loaded, so connected status may be incomplete.
composio.toast_connect_failed: Couldn't complete the connection. Please try again.
composio.legacy_connection: Legacy connection · disconnect when no longer needed
composio.gmail_description: Google Gmail and Google Workspace mail

outbound.title: Email
outbound.subject: Subject
outbound.review_hint: Send this version to the recipients above.
outbound.address_hint: One email address per line. Add files to the chat and ask the assistant to attach them.
outbound.sent_detail: Gmail accepted this message. Recipient delivery and read status are not tracked.
outbound.unknown_detail: Gmail may have accepted this message. Check Sent in Gmail before requesting a new draft; this message will not be resent automatically.
outbound.auth_failed: Gmail authorization is unavailable. Reconnect Gmail, then ask the assistant for a new draft.
outbound.failed_detail: This message was not accepted by Gmail. Check the account, recipients and attachments before requesting a new draft.
outbound.rate_limited: Gmail limited this request. Delivery will retry up to three times.
outbound.send_failed: Could not confirm the send request. Reload the email status before trying again.
outbound.save_failed: Could not save. Check the recipients and reload if the draft changed.
outbound.changed: The draft changed while you were editing. Cancel and review the latest version.
outbound.customer_description: Your latest 100 email drafts and sending records for this customer. Drafts are edited and sent in Chat.

reddit.description: Read public discussions and publish replies after a human review.
reddit.not_configured: Your administrator has not enabled Reddit authorization yet.
reddit.disconnect_description: Reading and queued replies will stop. Stored reply drafts for this account will be deleted.
reddit.error: The request failed. Check account permissions and try again.
reddit.empty_accounts: Connect a Reddit account to read public communities.
reddit.empty_posts: No posts found in this result. Try another search.
reddit.start_read: Choose an account and community, then read posts.
reddit.partial: This is a partial discussion. More comments may be available on Reddit.
reddit.empty_drafts: Drafts created here or by your agent appear here for review.
reddit.draft_help: This saves a draft. A workspace administrator reviews the exact account, target and text before sending.
reddit.retention: Drafts and delivery records expire after 48 hours. Source posts are read on demand.
reddit.review_help: This will publish the text below as a public Reddit comment using the selected account.
reddit.changed: The target changed or is no longer available. Edit the draft after reviewing the current discussion.
reddit.verify_help: The send result is unknown. Open Reddit to locate the comment, then enter its t1_ ID. Verification never resends.
reddit.permissions: Enable replies on this account before sending.
reddit.rate_limited: Reddit is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
reddit.target_changed: The target has changed. Review and save the draft again.
reddit.target_unavailable: The target is no longer available.
reddit.approval_unavailable: The approval is no longer valid.
reddit.receipt_unknown: No reliable receipt was received. Verify on Reddit before taking further action.
reddit.interrupted: Sending was interrupted. Verify the result on Reddit.
reddit.rejected: Reddit rejected this reply. Review the community rules and account permissions.
reddit.draft_placeholder: Write a helpful response grounded in this discussion…
reddit.invalid_response: The server returned an incomplete response. Refresh before continuing.
